mutants.name: greedy_restart_next
mutants.desc: greedy from the left pairing a[i],a[i+1]; on a mismatch restart the window at i+1 (known real model mistake)

mutants.name: ignore_distinct
mutants.desc: longest run of equal adjacent pairs, ignoring that each value may appear only twice

mutants.name: only_even_offset
mutants.desc: two-pointer over pairs starting at even indices only (forgets subarrays starting at odd index)

mutants.name: reset_on_dup
mutants.desc: on a repeated value, restarts the window at the current pair instead of just after the earlier occurrence

mutants.name: stale_last
mutants.desc: moves the left pointer to last[v]+2 without checking last[v] is inside the window (pointer can jump backwards)
